# asc_group_role (Resource)

Manages the assignment of a role to a authorization group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_name` (String) The name of the group.
- `role_name` (String) The name of the role to assign to the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this assignment.
